The children know our team by name.

They are the same faces every week. Our field staff are not visitors to Gaza — they live there, they are from there, and the families they deliver to are their neighbours. We are the UK charity that funds them, keeps the record, and tells you honestly what your money did.

Donate Read our latest project report
Hero image: one consented, dated photograph of a distribution in progress — hands, crates, a documentation clipboard. Not a devastation image. Caption carries location and month.
Registered Charity No. 1214384

A Charitable Incorporated Organisation registered in England and Wales.

Check our entry on the public register →
We deliver it ourselves

Through our own field operation and formally contracted local partners. Not through anonymous intermediaries.

How we work →
65 water tankers delivered

August 2025 – May 2026
Each one documented, reconciled and reported.

See our impact →
We report on the work we fund

Including the parts that were difficult.

Read the reports →
What we do

Six programmes. One standard of accountability.

Emergency Relief

A route opens, and it will not stay open long. We keep funds ready and suppliers agreed so our team can load a lorry the same week.

Food Assistance

The vegetables go first from the market stalls. We buy them for families who cannot, and we fund the pots for households with nothing left to cook on.

Clean Water

A child carrying a container twenty minutes each way, three times a day. We put that street on a tanker route.

Shelter

A family rebuilds a shelter the way you would expect: a tarpaulin one month, a door the next. We supply the pieces.

Orphan Support

A grandmother took in three more children and no more income. £50 a month goes straight to her.

Children & Wellbeing

Somewhere to go, something to do, and other children to do it with. On a good day you can hear it from the road.

See all our work →

A story, told properly

The eleven households at the end of the road

Updated monthly. Current entry:

At the end of a road in Rafah, eleven households were sharing one working water point. Twenty minutes there, twenty minutes back, three times a day, and mostly it was the children carrying it.

Our team assessed the street in February and added it to the tanker route. It is served twice a week now. The water comes from a supplier we have used since October, and his invoices and delivery notes sit in the project file.

That is all of it. Nobody's life was transformed, and we will not tell you it was. What changed is that eleven families got four hours of their day back, and the containers by the doors are full on a Tuesday.

"We know now which days the water comes. That sounds like a small thing. It is not a small thing." — Um Kareem, Rafah, March 2026. Recorded with consent.

Read the March water project report →

Coming soon

Current appeal

This section will show our live appeal — the need, a costed giving ladder, and progress so far — as soon as one is open. In the meantime you can give to where the need is greatest.

Give where most needed
Our impact

What was delivered, and over what period

August 2025 – May 2026

65water tankers delivered
183communal cooking pots — 10,970+ hot meal servings
571fresh vegetable baskets distributed
180families receiving food parcels
11tents installed
2,475+children reached through wellbeing activity

Some of these numbers are small. Eleven tents is eleven families, and we have left it at eleven rather than making it sound like more. Each figure comes from our field records and carries the months it covers. Where we do not have a number, we would rather tell you what we do know.

See the full impact record →

From the field
Coming soon

Field updates

Our three most recent field updates will appear here automatically once News & Updates is publishing.

All field updates →

Ways to give

Give once. Give monthly. Give Zakat.

Give once

To an appeal you have chosen, or leave it to our team to put where the need is greatest that week.

Donate

Give monthly

Knowing what is coming next month is what lets our team say yes to a family before an appeal is fully funded. It is quietly the most useful thing anyone gives us.

Set up monthly giving

Give Zakat

Zakat is recorded separately, applied only to Zakat-eligible purposes, and accounted for in accordance with our published Zakat Policy.
